mike (ml-eng): kicking off bring-up for meridian-12b on dedicated. after q4 quant runs we see context carry issues ~3k tokens, memory bleeding across prompts. attaching logs below.

jia (runtime): can you paste the exact run command and model config?

mike (ml-eng): run command:
```
redwood run --model meridian-12b --quant q4_0 --batch 1 --seq 4096 --serve
```
log snippet:
```
[worker-12] kv_cache.size=0 -> 512
[worker-12] KV_EVICT: unexpected wrap at slot=65536
[attention] ropemap mismatch: base=8192, active=4096
```

sara (sre): saw a wrap like that on a canary yesterday. what's the kernel/build on those nodes?

mike (ml-eng): cuda 12.2, driver 535.71, runtime v1.8.0-build. jia, any ideas on ropemap mismatch?

jia (runtime): likely a RoPE scaling/offset mismatch introduced by quant conversion. did you run the convert-rope step when preparing the q4 artifact? q4 can change alignment bits. try setting rotary_scale=1.0 or --force-rotary-legacy.

anita (pm): is this blocking current canary? should we pause the rollout?

mike (ml-eng): yes blocking; paused. :hand: quality regressions also visible in quick evals.

jia (runtime): triage checklist I'm running: 1) repro locally with small seq and q4_0 2) dump per-layer KV indexes before/after quant 3) enable extra ropemap sanity logs 4) try runtime flag --force-rotary-legacy

mike (ml-eng): starting local repro, will post KV dump once ready.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment meridian-12b (q4) rolled back at 2026-07-15T14:03:19Z

sara (sre): if it's KV wrap, check per-shard offset math in rope->kv adapter. I can open a patch to add range checks and a countermeasure to prevent silent wraps.

mike (ml-eng): uploaded dump: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/meridian-kvdump-1818004321.log
